typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFiles as string (),
	ArchiveFolderInbound as string (),
	DestinationTable as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FilePathInbound as string (),
	FilePathOutbound as string (),
	JobFileId as integer (),
	Path as string (),
	PathFileName as string (),
	PrintFiles as string (),
	RecordCountImz as integer (),
	RecordCountMem as integer (),
	RecordCountSqlmz as string (),
	RootFilePath as string (),
	TidalJobNumber as string (),
	varEmailMessage as string (),
	varEmailTo as string ()
}

source(output(
		PrintLine as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT PrintLine FROM     [EXTRACT].RegistryMemberPrint WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  JobFileId = ? ORDER BY PrintLineTypeId, SortId',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		PrintLine as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PrintLine)) ~> FlatFileDestination
